annual.label: Average yearly repair and maintenance cost (RepairPal)

maint.job: Synthetic blend oil and filter change
maint.every: Every 7,500–10,000 miles or per the oil-life monitor
maint.note: EcoBoost and ST engines are harder on oil; many owners change it sooner.

maint.job: Rear brake shoes and drums (pads and rotors on the ST)
maint.note: Most Fiestas have rear drum brakes; the ST has rear discs.

maint.every: About every 100,000 miles (sooner on the turbo engines)
maint.note: The 1.0L EcoBoost has three plugs; the 1.6L engines have four.

maint.every: First at about 100,000 miles, then every 50,000
maint.note: Keep a close eye on the coolant level on the ST and 1.0L EcoBoost.
